feeds_accelerator_ids.note: No dates: the relationship runs from the RCS's first 3 GeV beam (October 2007) to the present (hull of the two records). H- ions are stripped to protons at the RCS injection. Linac output: 181 MeV until the January 2014 energy upgrade, 400 MeV since.
feeds_accelerator_ids.quote: An H− beam is accelerated up to 400 MeV5 (181 MeV at present) by the LINAC, and is converted to an H+ beam by charge-stripping foils at the RCS injection.

intervals.label: 181 MeV operation (initial energy)
intervals.note: J-PARC's own history page words the January 2007 milestone as "Expected energy was achieved at Linac" (the first stage, 181 MeV, not the 400 MeV final design energy); the T2K instrumentation paper (2011) says "An H− beam is accelerated up to 400 MeV (181 MeV at present)". The earlier record carried this milestone as "design energy reached" with 400 MeV, which was wrong. End = the January 2014 upgrade ("2014 January Energy upgrade was achieved at Linac.").
intervals.quote: 2007 Jan：181MeV proton beam at J-PARC Linac

beam_energy.note: Cross-check: T2K paper, "181 MeV at present" (2011).
beam_energy.quote: 2007 Jan：181MeV proton beam at J-PARC Linac

intervals.label: 400 MeV operation (after the energy upgrade)
intervals.note: The J-PARC accelerator pages give 400 MeV for the linac ("A 400 MeV linear accelerator"); the month is the history page's entry.
intervals.quote: 2014 January Energy upgrade was achieved at Linac.

name: J-PARC linac
notes: The negative hydrogen ions are converted to protons by charge-stripping foils at RCS injection (T2K instrumentation paper).

beam_energy.note: The older "What is J-PARC" page adds "(currently operating at 180 MeV)"; the current facilities and linac pages give 400 MeV. 181 MeV was the energy from 2007 until the energy upgrade of January 2014 (KEK and J-PARC history pages); 400 MeV since.

summary.plain: The first machine in the J-PARC chain: a 300-metre linear accelerator that gives hydrogen ions their initial energy before they are passed to the ring accelerators.
summary.technical: 400 MeV normal-conducting H- linac (324/972 MHz RFQ, DTL, SDTL and ACS), about 300 m long, injecting into the 3 GeV RCS through charge-stripping foils.
